d: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar asserted that political differences should not impede developmental goals, stating, 'In politics we will compete, in development we will cooperate.' Addressing the Mekedatu balancing reservoir project, he maintained that Karnataka is actively pursuing forest and environmental clearances and remains committed to protecting Tamil Nadu's share of 177 TMC of water under Supreme Court directions.
